status.recommendation: Maintain the current component set as stable. Update descriptions, usage notes, token bindings, and confirmed property labels in scoped batches; do not add new component sets unless a reusable product pattern is confirmed.

safeUpdates: Update component descriptions and usage guidance.
Fix confirmed typos in descriptions or documentation.
Update token bindings to approved semantic/component aliases.
Normalize variant axes or values when the meaning is already confirmed.
Rename generated boolean/text properties only when the public meaning is clear.
requiresSeparateDecision: Add a new public component set.
Delete or detach an existing public component set.
Change component structure or interaction behavior.
Rename a public component family with medium/high consumer risk.
Merge component sets that may represent different product roles.
deferredQuestions: Confirm whether Tabbar should remain spelled as `Tabbar` or become `Tab Bar`.
Review Select Field and Input Field generated property suffixes before cleanup.
Map Icon variants to code icon names after implementation consumers exist.

proposals.figmaDescription: Dropdown/select field with label, description, placeholder/default value, error, disabled, and open states.
proposals.notes: Keep public name; clean generated property suffixes in a later reviewed Figma batch.

proposals.figmaDescription: Text input field with label, description, placeholder/default value, error, and disabled states.
proposals.notes: Keep aligned with Select Field; review why Open defaults differ.

proposals.figmaDescription: Icon-only button component with default, pressed, and disabled states.
proposals.notes: Renamed in Figma from Button to Button/Icon in Batch 05. Variant axis normalized to State with Default, Pressed, Disabled in Batch 06.

proposals.figmaDescription: Back/navigation button component with default and disabled states.
proposals.notes: Renamed in Figma from Button to Button/Back in Batch 05. Variant axis normalized to State with Default, Disabled in Batch 06.

proposals.figmaDescription: Secondary button component for low-emphasis actions with default, pressed, and disabled states.
proposals.notes: Renamed in Figma from btn_secondary to Button/Secondary in Batch 05. Variant axis normalized to State with Default, Pressed, Disabled in Batch 06.

proposals.figmaDescription: Primary button component for main actions with default, pressed, and disabled states.
proposals.notes: Renamed in Figma from btn_primary to Button/Primary in Batch 05. Variant axis normalized to State with Default, Pressed, Disabled in Batch 06.

variantDecision.meaning: `Chat` is a layout/content variant with a message entry row, not an interaction state.

proposals.figmaDescription: Bottom tab bar with default navigation and chat/message entry variants.
proposals.notes: Variant axis renamed in Figma from State to Variant. Chat adds a Message... entry row and compact tab labels. Keep public component set name unchanged until a separate naming decision is approved.

proposals.figmaDescription: Screen header with optional title, subtitle, right slot, and search variant.
proposals.notes: Header variant axis renamed from Property 1 to Variant; search value normalized to Search in Batch 05. Boolean properties renamed to Show Title, Show Subtitle, and Show Right Slot in Batch 07.
